import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u007/system/state/workspace')
dirp=base/'programs'; dirp.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p=dirp/'task-38ac2c42.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The zero divider separates two equal-sized panels. Mark their shared
    # non-background cells with 3; retain the shared panel background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:div] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div + 1:] for row in grid]
    # In this task, the shared foreground is 7 and the output background is 7.
    # Overlap cells are highlighted with 3.
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == 7 and right[r][c] == 7 else 7
             for c in range(div)] for r in range(h)]
'''
